asset.name: RouterAdapter
asset.description: Connects links, navigation, route state, navigation blocking, scroll restoration, prefetch policy, and transition direction to the consuming scenario's router.

requires.reason: Boundary types come from the shared framework-light vocabulary rather than being redeclared per adapter.

rationale: Template-seeded because every scenario has exactly one router and every page template depends on this port. Expressing route behavior as a port is also what keeps templates valid for the native targets, where no web router exists.
